author: Chandelis Duster
title: Police are investigating a man's death after he was pulled into MRI machine
description: New York police said the 61-year-old man was wearing a large metal chain that caused him to be "drawn into the machine." The FDA warns that MRI scan create a "strong, static magnetic field."
content:
Police are investigating a man's death after he was pulled into a Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) machine earlier this week.
